ko.description: 선택용 Query와 Key로 읽을 KV 위치를 고르는 원리를 살펴보고, 생성에 따른 선택 변화와 sliding window의 결합, 읽는 비용과 캐시 보관량을 구별합니다.

en.title: Sparse Attention Indexers: Choosing Positions by Content
en.description: Trace how an index query and keys select KV positions, how selection changes during generation, and how a sliding window combines with selection, while distinguishing reading cost from cache storage.
en.reviewNote: 2026-09-27: Compared all four sections and three figures with Korean. Preserved index/main QKV separation, dot-product scores, p6-to-p7 candidate sets, cache retention, window overlap rules, and qualified cost and quality trade-offs. Removed the final compression section in both languages as requested.

ko.title: 교사의 확률에서 학습 신호 얻기: OPD
ko.description: 학생이 생성한 문맥에서 교사의 토큰 확률을 읽고, 그 차이를 토큰별 학습 신호로 바꾸는 on-policy distillation과 Miles의 결합 방식을 살펴봅니다.

en.title: Learning from a Teacher’s Probabilities: OPD
en.description: Explore on-policy distillation, which reads a teacher’s token probabilities in student-generated contexts and turns the differences into token-level learning signals, and how Miles combines those signals.
en.reviewNote: 2026-09-27: Korean and English prose, four figures, KL formulas and numerical examples compared; footer captions removed in both languages.

ko.title: RL과 OPD를 조합하는 학습 전략
ko.description: DeepSeek V4의 전문 모델 학습과 OPD 통합에서 출발해, RL의 출발 정책을 준비하는 역할과 MiMo MOPD²의 교사·문맥 선택을 살펴봅니다.

en.title: Combining RL and OPD in a Training Strategy
en.description: Starting with DeepSeek V4’s specialist training and OPD integration, we examine how to prepare a starting policy for RL and how MiMo MOPD² chooses teachers and contexts.
en.reviewNote: 2026-09-27: Compared five bilingual sections, four figures and source claims; synchronized turn examples and removed obsolete evaluation-box reference. Checked desktop/mobile figure outputs.

ko.title: LLM RL 시스템은 어떻게 연결되는가
ko.description: 경험을 생성해 학습기로 보내고, 새 가중치를 추론기로 돌려보내는 두 흐름을 따라 LLM RL 시스템의 역할과 데이터, GPU 배치를 살펴봅니다.

en.title: How an LLM RL System Fits Together
en.description: Follow generated experience to the learner and updated weights back to the inference engine to understand the roles, data, and GPU placement in an LLM RL system.
en.reviewNote: Aligned closing paragraph with the combined TITO/R3 next article.

ko.title: 생성 기록을 학습으로 이어가기: TITO와 R3
ko.description: TITO로 실제 토큰 ID를 보존하고, R3로 생성 당시 선택한 MoE 전문가를 학습에서도 사용하는 과정을 살펴봅니다.

en.title: Carrying Generation Records into Training: TITO and R3
en.description: Preserve actual token IDs with TITO and reuse the MoE experts selected during generation with R3.
en.reviewNote: Aligned bilingual TITO/R3 consolidation and series references for the 16-article sequence.

ko.title: RL에서 양자화를 사용하는 방법
ko.description: 생성 비용을 줄이는 양자화가 학습과 추론의 계산을 어떻게 바꾸는지, BF16 학습·FP8 추론과 공통 양자화의 두 구성으로 살펴봅니다.

en.title: Using Quantization in RL
en.description: See how quantization reduces generation costs and changes training and inference computation, through shared quantization and BF16 training with FP8 inference.
en.reviewNote: Reviewed all four sections, two figures, rounding examples, shared-first order, and Miles v0.1 support boundaries against the Korean source.

ko.title: 토큰 축 압축: 여러 위치의 KV를 요약해서 읽기
ko.description: 내용 투영과 점수 투영으로 요약 벡터를 만드는 과정을 따라가고, 완성된 요약과 최근 위치별 KV를 함께 읽는 이유 및 인덱서와의 결합을 설명합니다.

en.title: Token-Axis Compression: Reading Summaries of Multiple KV Positions
en.description: Trace how content and score projections build summary vectors, why completed summaries are read alongside recent per-token KV, and how compression combines with an indexer.
en.reviewNote: Paragraph-by-paragraph Korean/English review; four bilingual figures, projection arithmetic, causal summary timing, overlapping recent entries, and storage/read counts checked on 2026-09-27.

ko.title: 생성 확률과 학습 확률이 달라지는 이유
ko.description: 계산 순서에 따른 차이를 줄이는 방법을 살펴보고, 남은 엔진 차이와 모델 버전 차이를 확률비로 다루는 원리를 설명합니다.

en.title: Why Generation and Training Probabilities Differ
en.description: Explore how to reduce differences caused by computation order, then use probability ratios to account for remaining engine and model-version differences.
en.reviewNote: Reviewed four sections and three bilingual figures against the Korean source, including rounding, alignment scope, engine/version differences, TIS and PPO clipping. Score Centering excluded.

ko.title: 비동기 RL과 오래된 데이터
ko.description: 생성과 학습을 겹치는 비동기 RL에서 배포 버전이 어떻게 바뀌고, 생성 중이거나 버퍼에 쌓인 경험을 언제 제외하는지 살펴봅니다.

en.title: Asynchronous RL and Stale Data
en.description: See how published rollout versions advance in asynchronous RL, and when to exclude experience that ages during generation or while waiting in a buffer.
en.reviewNote: Korean and English paragraphs, four figures, examples, terminology, alt text, and source scope reviewed on 2026-09-28.
